records.finding: The first part of the depth formula linearizes the ReShade buffer. Division by0.004 is for numerical stability, not by itself a conversion to meters.

records.author: yangzhou24
records.finding: Game depth is captured directly through ReShade. The learned stereo/sparse-prior pipelines concern different OmniWorld subdatasets.

records.author: yangzhou24
records.finding: The owner suggests aligning scene depth to MoGe-2 predicted metric depth using a sampled-frame median ratio as a practical approximate metric solution.
A later release announces Metric Scale and documents a scene-specific factor for depth and camera translation.

temporal_interpretation: The historical comments do not disprove the later metadata release; the later release still needs per-factor derivation and independent physical validation for a strict metric calibration claim.
not_established: That the currently released CSV factors were actually computed with MoGe-2
That Metric3D was used to compute them
An independently measured physical-length calibration and error bound for the selected UIDs
